pricing.heading: What Does a New Garage Door Cost in the
pricing.description: The UK average for a professionally installed garage door sits around £850. Most homeowners spend between £500 and £1,200, while full projects range from £800 to £3,500.

infoCards.title: Installation Labour
infoCards.description: Covers removal, fitting, hardware, and post-install balance check. UK rates typically £60–£95/hr.

infoCards.title: Door & Hardware
infoCards.description: Entry-level steel starts lowest. Timber, composite, or full-view glass can reach £6,000+.

infoCards.title: Insulation Rating
infoCards.description: British winters demand proper insulation. An insulated door cuts heat loss and energy bills year-round.

infoCards.title: VAT & Permits
infoCards.description: Standard UK VAT applies at 20%. Building regs approval may be needed for structural changes.
